scenario.title: High-anxiety patient, focus on rapport
scenario.patient_background: First time in an emergency department, lives alone, fears the worst.

transcript.content: Hi Nina, I'm Dana, one of the nurses looking after you this evening. I know waiting for these results is hard.
I'm terrified something is seriously wrong with my heart.
That fear makes complete sense given what you're going through right now, and it's okay to feel that way.
Nobody else has really acknowledged that.
I hear you, and I'm not going to judge you for being scared -- most people would feel exactly the same in your position.
